title: Retrieval-augmented generation in medicine: A scoping review of technical implementations, clinical applications, and ethical considerations
impact: 最新医学 RAG 范围综述指出临床验证、跨语言适配、低资源环境、安全和偏差评估仍明显不足。

title: LLM-Generated Text May Harm Your Retrieval! A Robust Detection Strategy for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Zhaoheng Huang; Yutao Zhu; Ji-Rong Wen; Zhicheng Dou
impact: 说明外部语料被模型生成内容污染会持续降低检索可靠性，来源治理需要增加内容来源和污染检测。

title: Evaluating and Guarding Citation Faithfulness in Agentic Scientific Synthesis
impact: 同一输出的不支持引用率会因验证器严格度从约 3% 变化到约 18%，提出金标准校准和 conformal guard。

title: Efficiency vs. Verifiability in Evidence-Aware RAG: Does Prompt Compression Preserve Citation Grounding?
authors: Aiyu Li; Qian Peng; Bin Chen
impact: 表明压缩上下文可能保持答案质量却显著破坏引用 grounding，成本优化必须加入引用保持指标。

title: Medical multi-recall embedding: Adaptive retrieval for diverse evidence in medical RAG systems
impact: 一对多医学检索在五个专科平均提升 Recall@10 超过 10 个百分点，并使下游 QA 至少提升 4 个百分点。

title: BRIDGE: benchmarking large language models for understanding real-world clinical practice texts
impact: 以 59 个真实临床数据源、9 种语言、87 项任务评估 95 个模型，显示模型、语言、专科和任务间差异巨大。

title: When silence is safer: a review and decision-theoretic framework for LLM abstention in healthcare
impact: 提出 MedSAFE 和基于潜在伤害的决策论拒答框架，强调回答、澄清、转诊和拒答不应合并成一个置信度。

title: General-purpose large language models outperform specialized clinical AI tools on medical benchmarks
impact: 独立盲评显示专用临床工具并不天然优于前沿通用模型，证明真实临床问题和独立评估比产品标签更重要。

title: MR-RAG: Multimodal Relevance-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Visual Question Answering
impact: 在检索与生成两阶段同时建模跨模态相关性，在三个医学视觉 QA 数据集上最高提升 6.4%。

title: AgenticRAG: Agentic Retrieval for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
impact: 将 search/find/open/summarize 变成受控迭代工具，报告 BRIGHT Recall@1 比最佳 embedding 基线高 21.8 个百分点。

title: CRITIC-R1: Learning Structured Critics for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
impact: 把 RAG 批评建模为显式错误诊断并以过程级监督学习，可用于定位检索、归因和推理故障。

title: CRITIC-RAG: Knowledge-Augmented Large Language Models With Verified Retrieval for Improved Medical Reasoning
authors: Jin Li; Lei Lu; Yongming Miao; Yu Tian; Jingsong Li
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
impact: 小型独立 verifier 贯穿选择性检索、过滤、自一致推理和 groundedness 核验；LLaMA-3 的 MedQA 从 41.3% 升至 48.8%。

title: Reason and Verify: A Framework for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Eeham Khan; Luis Rodriguez; Marc Queudot
impact: 结合查询改写、交叉编码重排、子结论到精确片段绑定和八类忠实度诊断，在 BioASQ/PubMedQA 验证。

title: Evaluating large language models for evidence-based clinical question answering
impact: 两万多问答显示结构化指南准确率 90%，系统综述仅 50%–60%；模型对模糊和弱证据普遍过度自信。

title: Look as You Think: Unifying Reasoning and Visual Evidence Attribution for Verifiable Document RAG via Reinforcement Learning
impact: 用页码和 bounding box 把推理步骤绑定到视觉证据区域，平均提升 soft EM 8.23% 和 IoU@0.5 47.0%。

title: Faithful in Steps: Improving Generalization and Citation in RAG via Query Decomposition
impact: 将复杂问题拆成原子子问题并重排去除干扰，减少多跳与多模态任务中的过度引用和隐式实体遗漏。

title: Tiny-Critic RAG: Empowering Agentic Fallback with Parameter-Efficient Small Language Models
impact: 以小模型做确定性检索门控，报告路由准确率接近 GPT-4o-mini、延迟低一个数量级，适合控制 verifier 成本。

title: Agentic memory-augmented retrieval and evidence grounding for medical question-answering tasks
impact: 把检索、重排、证据 grounding、诊断工具和 cache-and-prune memory 合并为动态多步医学 Agent。

title: Multi-Evidence Clinical Reasoning With Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Emergency Triage: Retrospective Evaluation Study
authors: Hang Sheung Wong; Tsz Kwan Wong
impact: 指南与 3000 个历史病例双源检索使 236 个真实分诊病例准确率从 0.542 升至 0.802，并将过度分诊从 28.8% 降至 12.7%。

title: MedRAGChecker: Claim-Level Verification for Biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
impact: 以原子 claim、医学 NLI 和知识图谱一致性区分忠实度不足、证据不足、矛盾和安全关键错误。

title: Web Search Is Not Enough: LLMs Fail to Account for Paper Retraction Status
impact: 显示仅进行网页检索仍可能把撤稿论文当作有效证据，来源生命周期必须独立建模。
